verified_static_contract.preparation_slots: prepare_binding_slots replays source packet, optional supplied recording and preflight; returns one original-order physical item, null unsubmitted slot, and one null caller sidecar slot per received declaration. It generates no completed review or scope declaration.
verified_static_contract.upstream_custody: _setup detaches packet/submissions/optional receipts and calls recorder.validate_recording and preflight.validate_preflight before using fields. _closing repeats the same validations/context reads and compares packet/submissions/recording/preflight endpoint bytes.
verified_static_contract.sidecar_binding: Closed sidecar header joins packet canonical digest, exact submission ID+full content digest, complete item-declaration digest, full immutable physical/source/context envelope and exact full source/context request digest. Unique pair/submission-item and global binding_id required.
verified_static_contract.complete_context: Request always preserves identity-normalized complete raw-section text with declared_context role, empty unresolved context bindings and its raw UTF8 SHA. Scope input/declaration exact bytes must match request; no truncation, none_required substitution or official-HTML relabeling.
verified_static_contract.source_context_coordinates: Original source role anchors use selected-source Unicode characters; context occurrences translate by item selected_char_start. Literal slices and source/UTF8 physical selectors remain replayed by unchanged packet/recorder owners. Equal text cannot substitute a different physical envelope.
verified_static_contract.explicit_maps: All maps are closed and bounded. Completed joins require original ordered exhaustive rule and modality lists, every rule/facet/qualifier slot, every original anchor and attachment. Rule/canonical aliases compare only explicit declarations, never infer source meaning.
verified_static_contract.repeated_leaf_sites: Each qualifier index binds an exact graph path, facet and affected rule. Duplicate (rule,path) sites refuse; supplied set equals every actual leaf site×affected rule; per-rule/facet leaf order preserves local-first then inner-to-outer shared attachment traversal.
verified_static_contract.shared_attachments: Each original attachment joins an explicit group path with same facet, exact affected-rule membership set, and each original attached anchor inside that group. Shared references cannot be silently narrowed/dropped.
verified_static_contract.binder_geometry: Existing scope validator runs before _join and validates occurrence facets, declared binder variable/domain, attachment paths, scope containment, repeated use outside scope and unique associations. Typechecking/legal quantifier meaning remain false.
verified_static_contract.declaration_transport: Existing canonical statement_scope_v1 FAMILY_EXTENSION BridgeView carries exact declared payload and CID; exact serialized reconstruction validated. No flat canonical projection, native AST lowering, formal target or accepted family output is created.
verified_static_contract.status_preservation: Physical item order, complete original declaration entry, preflight diagnostics/status, recording dispute, scope sidecar and unresolved/coverage/binder content remain visible. Successful scope transport never upgrades partial, inconsistent, unresolved or disputed review status.
verified_static_contract.exact_replay: validate_binding rebuilds the complete receipt from retained packet/submissions/sidecars/optional upstream receipts and compares canonical full JSON bytes. Repaired nested/outer seals do not bypass source/maps/status/view/authority regeneration.
verified_static_contract.import_boundary: Eager imports are collections/copy and five existing pure legal IR owners. No direct model/numerical/test/backend/compiler imports or calls exist in new source. This does not establish complete package-initializer or transitive import behavior.

closed_map_shapes.partial_null_meaning: Null scope declaration/map is unanswered and unassessed; explicit empty map is cardinality-checked on complete sidecar.
closed_map_shapes.canonical_symbol_scope: Explicit alias equality only. Source literal and declared canonical symbol can differ without claiming semantic normalization.

limits.limit_status: profile_limit preserves full supplied sidecar/physical/source bindings. Header/input/body seals and closed bounded map rows are checked, while out-of-profile graphs explicitly remain unvalidated.
limits.complete_bridge_wrapper: Payload and complete wrapper caps are distinct. A valid payload can be graph-checked yet profile-limited after adding BridgeView wrapper; view remains absent and scope_bridge_transport_validated=false.
limits.ordinary_transport: Duplicate-key/invalid UTF8/nonordinary values refused through inherited strict parser. Floats and floating score packets are refused; closed review/sidecar schemas constrain the supplied structure.
limits.complete_result_limit: Oversized aggregate result or excessive JSON depth/node count fails closed; no selected subset or dropped nested evidence is returned.

statuses.trigger: Original archival trigger list is retained verbatim. It has no rule association in old schema, so trigger_to_rule_linkage_assessed remains false.
